pages.text: Serene Seasons divides the year into four seasons: $(item)Spring$(), $(item)Summer$(), $(item)Autumn$() and $(item)Winter$().$(br2)Every crop has a set of seasons it can grow in. When the current season is not in that set, the crop is $(warn)out of season$(): it stops growing, and may wither.

pages.title: Season sources
pages.text: A crop's allowed seasons come from $(bold)two sources merged together$():$(li)the $(info)Serene Seasons datapack tags$() (plus other mods' adapters)$(li)this mod's $(thing)seedSeasons$() config list$(br2)This means crops already tagged by the datapack keep working even if you delete their config entry. The config only $(bold)adds$() to the datapack.

pages.title: Tooltips
pages.text: Crop items and seeds show a tooltip: $(info)Matures in X days$().$(br2)Seeds whose seasons were set through this mod's config also show their season words on the tooltip.
